pos.personaBrief: No verified evidence on possession; from general knowledge, his Brazil and Flamengo sides kept the ball with Zico and Total Football inspiration (verified Michels-style 1977 fact).

pro.personaBrief: No verified evidence on progression; general knowledge suggests organized, quick vertical football with safe build-up, in line with the Total Football model.

est.personaBrief: Verified: he tried to implement a Total Football style modelled on Michels, with its fluid, interchangeable roles, and his own philosophy; but with defined phases and rehearsed organization.

lar.personaBrief: No verified evidence on width; general knowledge: Total Football with overlapping full-backs and playmakers like Zico through the middle, not classic wingers.

blo.personaBrief: No verified evidence on block; Total Football lineage and general knowledge of his pressing, compact and fit teams imply high pressing.

mar.personaBrief: No verified evidence on marking; general knowledge says he brought zonal marking in the Total Football mould.

pla.personaBrief: Verified: he took command and tried to implement his own philosophy, imposing his model on players.

res.personaBrief: Verified titles at Flamengo (Carioca 1978, 1979, Brasileiro 1980) and a World Cup bronze; general knowledge: pragmatic yet ambitious, valuing winning.

sis.personaBrief: Verified: imposed his own philosophy and a Total Football system with collective duties for everyone, even stars like Zico.

jog.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: pioneering physical-preparation coach, favouring fitness while still using technical players.

bas.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: titles won with a mix of Flamengo academy products and veterans, leaning on experience for titles.

lid.personaBrief: No verified evidence; general knowledge: an army-captain background, a disciplinarian whose command was firm.
